core_obligations: Reduce: choose a factorization of the homomorphism through a polynomial ring over the source, so that the target becomes a perfect module over that polynomial ring (proof lines 4901-4903)
Unfold the shriek: the shriek of a complex is the internal hom out of the target applied to the tensor of the complex with the shifted polynomial ring (proof line 4904)

Substitute: the tensor description of the internal hom out of a perfect module and the double base change identity turn that expression into the tensor of the original complex with the shriek of the structure sheaf (proof lines 4905-4907)
proof_roadmap: 取分解 R → P → A，P 为多项式环，则 A 是完美 P-模（perfect-ring-map 引理）。
由定义 φ^!(K) = RHom(A, K ⊗_R^L P[n])；由 RHom-is-tensor-special（A 完美）把它写成张量积形式。
再用 double-base-change 把两个张量因子合并为 K ⊗_R^L φ^!(R)，即所求。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that for a perfect homomorphism of Noetherian rings the upper shriek is tensoring with its value on the structure sheaf (author lemma at source lines 4889-4894, label lemma-upper-shriek-is-tensor-functor). The proof (source lines 4897-4908) factors the homomorphism through a polynomial ring over which the target is perfect, unfolds the definition of the shriek as an internal hom out of the target into a shifted tensor product, and substitutes the tensor description of that internal hom together with the double base change identity to obtain the asserted formula (proof lines 4904-4907). The substitution chain is the substance. H2.
